run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser. Each case calls the inbound API as sf.integration — the same user the named credential uses, because the echo-loop guard keys off it — and re-reads the task over cnit before and after to prove nothing was written.

case.title: Unknown sys_id returns 404

steps.text: Confirm the sys_id matches no CAF Task, so the case cannot accidentally address a real record.
PATCH the unknown sys_id with an otherwise entirely valid, allow-listed body.
Confirm no task anywhere picked up the body.

expected: HTTP 404, body "CAF Task not found: deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef".
The 404 is decided before the allow-list, so a body of writable fields still writes nothing.
actual: HTTP 404 in 172ms — {"result":{"error":"CAF Task not found: deadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeefdeadbeef"}}
No task on the instance holds the canary comment.
case.verdictReason: 404 with the sys_id named in the message; the valid body wrote nowhere.
